title: Finite cotensor corner preserves local acyclic fibrations
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$ given by covering sieves: a sieve is a set of arrows into an object closed under precomposition, the maximal sieve covers, and covering sieves satisfy pullback stability and transitivity. Use [def-weil-size-convention] for universes and [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] for associated sheaves and [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] for simplicial sets. For $V\in\mathcal C$, put $h_V(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(W,V)$. The simplex $\Delta^n$ is represented by $[n]$, its boundary $\partial\Delta^n$ is the union of its proper faces (empty when $n=0$), and $\Lambda_i^n$ is the union of the faces other than face $i$, for $n\ge1$ and $0\le i\le n$. Let $F,G:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be objectwise Kan simplicial presheaves. A map $f:F\to G$ is a local Kan fibration if every commutative square from $h_V\times\Lambda_i^n\to h_V\times\Delta^n$ to $f$ has fillers after restriction along every arrow in some covering sieve of $V$; the fillers need not agree for different arrows. For objectwise Kan $F,G$, call $f$ a local weak equivalence if it induces an isomorphism on the associated sheaves of $\pi_0$ and, for each $V\in\mathcal C$, $x\in F(V)_0$ and $m\ge1$, an isomorphism on the associated sheaves on $\mathcal C/V$ of $\pi_m(F|_{\mathcal C/V},x)\to\pi_m(G|_{\mathcal C/V},f(x))$, where $\mathcal C/V$ has the induced topology. For a simplicial set $A$, define the objectwise cotensor by $(F^A)(V)_q=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathsf{sSet}}(A\times\Delta^q,F(V))$. If $f$ is both a local Kan fibration and a local weak equivalence, and $i:K\hookrightarrow L$ is an inclusion of finite simplicial sets (finitely many nondegenerate simplices), then the objectwise cotensor corner map
$$F^L\longrightarrow F^K\times_{G^K}G^L$$
has objectwise Kan domain and codomain and is again a local Kan fibration and a local weak equivalence (hence a local acyclic fibration).

source.place: Dugger--Hollander--Isaksen, Proposition 3.3 (published numbering; v2 Proposition 3.3), Section 3, pp. 7-8; finite cotensor corner map.
